budgets.execution_policy: declared-for-later-adapters; not proof of current enforcement

claim_ceiling: Candidate route selection and declarative resource bounds; no logical verdict, source meaning acceptance, installation or runtime authority.

smt-projection.claim_ceiling: Exact solver/projected formula evidence under separately established encoding and runtime; cannot satisfy mechanized-theorem minimum by a solver label.

static-model-evaluator.claim_ceiling: Truth in an exact supplied complete finite structure only.
